Given a question and an answer, analyze the complexity of each sentence in the answer. Break down each sentence into one or more fully understandable statements. Ensure that no pronouns are used in any statement. Format the outputs in JSON.
Please return the output in a JSON format that complies with the following schema as specified in JSON Schema:
{"properties": {"statements": {"description": "The generated statements", "items": {"type": "string"}, "title": "Statements", "type": "array"}}, "required": ["statements"], "title": "StatementGeneratorOutput", "type": "object"}Do not use single quotes in your response but double quotes,properly escaped with a backslash.

--------EXAMPLES-----------
Example 1
Input: {
    "question": "Who was Albert Einstein and what is he best known for?",
    "answer": "He was a German-born theoretical physicist, widely acknowledged to be one of the greatest and most influential physicists of all time. He was best known for developing the theory of relativity, he also made important contributions to the development of the theory of quantum mechanics."
}
Output: {
    "statements": [
        "Albert Einstein was a German-born theoretical physicist.",
        "Albert Einstein is recognized as one of the greatest and most influential physicists of all time.",
        "Albert Einstein was best known for developing the theory of relativity.",
        "Albert Einstein also made important contributions to the development of the theory of quantum mechanics."
    ]
}
-----------------------------

Now perform the same with the following input
input: {
    "question": "user: What is the process to estimate the cost for Direct Link offerings?\nassistant: To estimate the cost for Direct Link offerings, follow these steps:\n1. Log in to the IBM Cloud Direct Link console (<https://cloud.ibm.com/interconnectivity/direct-link>).\n2. Click 'Order Direct Link'.\n3. Choose to order either Direct Link Connect or Direct Link Dedicated.\n4. As you complete the ordering form, cost estimates will appear in the Summary side panel.\nThese cost estimates can help you understand the expenses associated with Direct Link offerings.\nuser: Do I have to use a VRF with Direct Link?\nassistant: No, the new Direct Link does not require the use of a Virtual Routing and Forwarding (VRF) instance. Direct Link allows connectivity to both classic Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS) and Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs), and it can be used without a VRF. However, if you want to take advantage of certain features like connecting to the classic IaaS network, then IBM Cloud Direct Link requires you to use a VRF (Virtual Routing and Forwarding) instance. VRF isn't fully compatible with the IBM Cloud SSL and IPsec VPN services. you may need to use a VRF. The choice depends on your specific use case and requirements.\nThe document states:\n\"Direct Link allows connectivity to both classic IaaS as well as VPCs, whereas IBM Cloud Direct Link on Classic always connects to the IaaS network and a global VRF first.\" This suggests that while Direct Link on Classic requires a VRF, the new Direct Link offering does not necessarily need one.\nuser: Can I change pricing plans whenever?\nassistant: Sorry, but I do not have that information.\nuser: I meant can I change from metered pricing to unmetered anytime?",
    "answer": "Yes—you can change from metered to unmetered billing after your Direct Link is provisioned, whether you use global or local routing. [S7]\n\nTo change it:\n1. Open your Direct Link’s Details page and click **Edit**.\n2. In the side panel’s **Billing** section, select **Unmetered**.\n3. Review the updated information, agree to the prerequisites, and click **Submit**. [S7]\n\nThe document does not specify when the change takes effect or whether there are timing restrictions, so it does not establish “anytime” beyond confirming that changes are allowed after provisioning."
}
